# Busy Strong 90 — Coach Milos Ilic

> Busy Strong 90 is a strength and nutrition coaching program by Milos Ilic (Coach Milos), a personal trainer and online fitness coach based in Dubai, UAE. It is built for busy parents and professionals over 35: three strength workouts a week of about 22 minutes, protein in every meal without calorie counting, progressive overload and a weekly check-in.

About the coach:
- Milos Ilic, personal trainer in Dubai with 15 years of coaching experience
- 3rd place at Mr. Universe, Serbian bodybuilding champion
- Father of two; trains the same short way his clients do
- Coaches in person in Dubai and online worldwide
